Claude refinement: 61 line(s) suggested — Kraken mangled most words in this cursive hand (headings and dates, names such as salvadore del chanattiere, Becho ghanegli, Govanni, and sums such as ⫳ 5.12, ⫳ 22.8, ⫳ sej, ⫳ iiijº); I restored them from the image and from the internal cross-checks between the sums. | layout: l8: this box sits between l18 and l20 on the page (it is the second line of the Richordo entry) but is numbered 8 in the reading order; move it after l18; l7, l29, l36, l50, l63: margin numbers (25, 17/7, 17, 12, 19) sit partly inside the boxes and were left out of the text; l69: the box reaches far below the line, over the blank lower margin and the page edge; l70, l71, l72: these are cross-reference numbers (9, 10, 8) in the column right of the text, not sums | doubts: l3, l9, l13, l14, l20, l43, l68: one looped p/f-shaped glyph serves more than one purpose. It is ƒ (florins) where it is followed by 'larghi' (l68 'ƒ iiijº larghi' = ⫳ 22.8; l43 likewise), ꝑ in 'ꝑmo' (l17) and 'dacchordo ꝑ ⫳ xij' (l20), and ß (soldi) in l7 '⫳ undici ß iiij' (matches the sum ⫳ 11.4). In l9 ('Govanni ß antonio') and l14 its meaning is unclear, so Kraken's ß is kept there; l1: the first letter of the year looks like a looped d; it is probably M (Mccccº Lxvj = 1466); l27: the day looks like η; I read it as 2, which fits between 1 and 7 November (l17, l67). Kraken read it as 11; l41: I read 'ventuno', but the entry total is ⫳ 23.10 (l48), with l46 adding something ('piu ...'), so check it; l3: 'ƒ mezo larghi' does not obviously give the sum ⫳ 28. Perhaps 'ƒ v mezo'; l12, l16, l26, l33, l36, l46, l47, l51, l57–l60, l64: the readings are still uncertain; uncertain words are marked [?], and I left Kraken's text where I could not do better; l21/l8: I took 'lanzani' and 'lauoratº' as the same words in both lines; this is uncertain
